description.after:
The Threaded Highline Leash Kit is the complete solution to tying into your highline! It comes with your choice of length threaded leash constructed from a 9.8mm Dynamic Rope threaded through 11/16" Slack-Spec Tubular, your choice of leash rings, and a protection sleeve for where the leash is connected to the leash rings.
Built from high quality materials, this leash is made to withstand many leash falls. We have put this leash through exhaustive testing involving several hundred leash falls onto the same leash with zero signs of wear. If you are looking for a burly leash that you can trust your life to, this is one to get.
The leash itself is the perfect length to allow you to have a strong knot with a backup knot on both ends and still have enough room for an adequately long leash. The girth of the leash as well as the soft hand makes for an easy climb after a leash fall.

description.after:
The SlackTech Highline Leash Kit has the all the components necessary to keep you safely connected to your highline. The leash is comprised of 12 ft of 9.9 mm Dynamic rope threaded inside a finely woven 11/16" tubular nylon. The leash is tied with a figure 8 knot to two 2 5/16" drop forged steel rings. The SlackTech Highline Leash Kit is designed to meet the rigors of repeated highining.
Dynamic rope threaded inside tubular webbing creates leash that is highly abrasion resistant and slightly stiffer than dynamic rope alone. This makes for more stable leash ring movement while walking because the rings are less prone to whipping around. The leash girth also provides a more friendly experience while leash climbing after that big whip; it's soft on both your hands and your feet!
The two 2 5/16" drop forged steel rings provide huge security when out in the middle of your highline. There are no seams, burs or welds in these rings, just pure strength! Each ring has been proof loaded to 3,600 lbf and are paired together to distribute the load of a leash fall over a larger surface of the highline.

notes.after: SlackTech closed. The kit's 'Leash Only' option: US$45.95 less $15.50 in 2014 (stored). 12 ft. Made in USA.
